title: Check Whether a Binary Tree is Height Balanced
problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, determine whether the tree is height balanced. A binary tree is height balanced if, for every node, the difference between the heights of its left and right subtrees is at most one.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
output: • Print YES if the tree is height balanced; otherwise print NO.
